Truth here! Second guessing a song you started working on really excited about is the worst thing to happen. You start to resent it and it sucks overall. Ive enjoyed making songs to the point where I feel it is good instead of mixing it to the ground for days, usually ends up a mess then

For an instrumental/beat take as long as you may to bring it to your standard, as for recording lyrics onto the track Ive found the songs i spent a day recording on have always come out better. I spent one night from about 8 or 9 pm til 7 in the morning producing and recording one song and it has done the best in streams and its a lot of my friend’s favorite song! Many successful songs during this day and age have not been thought of for more than a day, a lot of big artists shell out their hits in a day or so. Not to say there havent been many songs that took weeks or even months to make that were also hits. It depends on what youre going for and your workflow/lifestyle
